# 1. Establish the Grand Council (Junjichu) (one-time centralization overhaul)
oe_qg2_dec_establish_grand_council = {
	decision_category = country_specific_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_qg2_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1690
		OR = {
			owns = location:dadu
			num_locations >= 35
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_dec_grand_council_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_qg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 260
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_qg2_dec_establish_grand_council.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_dec_establish_grand_council_tt
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -260
			set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_dec_grand_council_done value = 1 }
			oe_qg2_add_centralization = { amt = 25 }
			add_stability = 5
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qg2_mod_grand_council_cabinet years = 40 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

			text = oe_qg2_dzungar_cd_tt

	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_qg2_dec_dzungar_expedition.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_dec_dzungar_expedition_tt
			oe_qg2_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -220
			set_variable = { name = oe_qg2_dzungar_cd value = 1 years = 15 }

		}
	}
}

# 3. Charter the Canton Thirteen Factories (one-time maritime commerce institution)
oe_qg2_dec_charter_canton_factories = {
	decision_category = country_specific_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_qg2_is_host = yes
		current_year >= 1720
		OR = {
			owns = location:guangzhou
			owns = location:panyu
			has_non_rural_port = yes
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_qg2_dec_canton_done }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_qg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 200
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:soldiers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_qg2_dec_charter_canton_factories.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_dec_charter_canton_factories_tt
